gameDescriptionHtml:
Pathfinder: Gallowspire Survivors is a new roguelite survivor game set in the beloved fantasy world of Pathfinder. Venture into Gallowspire, Pathfinder’s legendary tower of darkness, as one of three heroes — and alongside a fearless companion — on a doomed quest to seal away the greatest threat the world has ever known.

You won’t have to face the darkness alone. Invite a friend to take over one of your heroes and act as your companion. Your companion always follows you into battle and levels alongside your main character. Your companions will be as powerful as you have grown them to be! You can play Co-op through Steam Remote Play or locally.

Absorb necromantic essence to find and enhance attacks and passives each run to grow stronger against Tar-Baphon’s forces. Use attribute points to increase Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma. Upgrade your talent tree and get deeper customization options by unlocking new attacks and passive abilities.

Explore dungeons, find hidden treasure chests, and let fate decide your fortune with d20 rolls. Use gold to upgrade potent consumables like healing potions and spell-like effects. Find Tyrant’s statues to unlock permanent upgrades. We tied them with collectible cards that showcase incredible Paizo’s art from monsters to items.

Game Features

  • Choose from Fighter, Rogue, or Wizard, each with unique abilities and styles.
  • Engage in meticulously crafted boss fights that elevate the challenge.
  • Dive into an arsenal of 67+ abilities and 36+ talents for endless strategy.
  • Explore 16 floors across 3 biomes, battling 12 mini-bosses and 4 epic bosses.
  • Enjoy the community-requested features like hyper mode, aim & dash mechanics, potion belts, detailed character sheets, and more.
  • Discover official Pathfinder art collectibles for permanent hero enhancements.
  • Fight your way through 5 difficulty levels for a more challenging journey.
  • Team up with friends through Steam Remote Play and battle your way to victory together.
  • Fully Steam Deck compatible for gaming on the go.
